summary: Pierre-Amédée Jaubert was a scholar in linguistics and Iranian and Central Asian studies. He studied at the École nationale des langues orientales vivantes under Antoine-Isaac Silvestre de Sacy, later directing it (~1838–1847) and holding a professorship at the Collège de France (1838–1847).
Pierre-Gustave Garrez was an Indologist. He completed his studies at Lycée Henri-IV and Lycée Louis-le-Grand.

Pierre-Philippe Giraudeau worked in Tibetology and religious studies. He studied at the Séminaire des Missions Étrangères de Paris (~1874–1877), became a missionary with the Paris Foreign Missions Society in 1877, and served as Vicar Apostolic of Kangding (1901–1936).

Pierre-Sylvain Filliozat specialized in Indology and linguistics. He studied at INALCO, the EPHE, and under Louis Renou, M. S. Narasimhacharya, and N. R. Bhatt. He held the Chair of Sanskrit at the EPHE from 1967 to 2004.
Pieter Cornelis Verhagen is a scholar of Tibetology, Indology, and linguistics. He completed his Ph.D. at Leiden University by 1991 and served there as a research fellow, attested in 1996.

Pieter Hendrik Pott worked in history, archaeology, Tibetology, and Indology. He studied at Utrecht University and Leiden University under Frederik David Kan Bosch, later serving as curator at the National Museum of Ethnology (1947–1982) and professor at Leiden (1973–1983).
Pieter Jacob Cosijn was a linguist who studied at Utrecht University (~1858–1865). He held a post at Leiden University from 1877 to 1899.

Pietro Merlo specialized in linguistics and Indology. He studied at the University of Turin under Giovanni Flechia and Giovanni Maria Bertini, later serving as an ordinary professor of comparative classical and Romance linguistics at the University of Pavia from 1885.
Ping-kun Chen works in philosophy and Buddhist studies. He completed his doctorate at National Taiwan University (2001–2010), where he was appointed assistant professor in 2012.

Piotr Balcerowicz is an Indologist and philosopher. He studied at the University of Warsaw, Banaras Hindu University, and the University of Hamburg. He has held professorships at SWPS University (2008–2011) and the University of Warsaw from 2011.

Piotr Klafkowski was a scholar of Tibetology and linguistics. He earned his PhD at Adam Mickiewicz University in Poznań under Jerzy Bańczerowski and studied under traditional teachers including Lozang Jamspal, Geshe Geleg Gyatsho, and Jampa Kelzang Rinpoche.

Piyanjali de Zoysa works in religious and Buddhist studies. After studying at the University of Delhi, she earned her Ph.D. at the University of Colombo (2002–2006), where she became Professor in Clinical Psychology (appointed 1997).

Po Lu Khenpo Dorjé was a figure in Tibetology and Buddhist studies. He studied under Khenpo Ngawang Pelzang and Jamyang Khyentse Chökyi Lodrö, and his students included Taklung Tsetrul Rinpoche and Chagdud Tulku Rinpoche.

Poerbatjaraka worked in linguistics, Indology, and archaeology. He earned his doctorate at Leiden University (~1921–1926) under Nicolaas Johannes Krom, later serving as a professor at Gadjah Mada University, the University of Indonesia, and Udayana University.

Polly Young-Eisendrath works in Buddhist and religious studies. She studied at Ohio University, Goddard College, and Washington University in St. Louis, and underwent Zen training under Philip Kapleau. She became a clinical associate professor in psychiatry at the University of Vermont in 1994.

Pongsit Pangsrivongse works in Buddhist studies and Indology. He studied at the University of Cambridge and the University of Oxford, and was appointed University Assistant in Pre-Modern South Asian Studies at the University of Vienna in 2025.

Pooja Tomar is an Indology and philosophy scholar. She studied at the University of Delhi (2013–2019) and earned her PhD in 2022 from Shri Mata Vaishno Devi University, where she also worked as a research scholar.

Popatbhai Ambashankar Mankad worked in Indology, history, and archaeology. He held posts as State Engineer in Junagadh, Chief Engineer in Jodhpur State, and Chief Officer and Engineer for the Hyderabad Municipality.
Pori Park specializes in Buddhist and religious studies. She studied under Robert E. Buswell Jr. and served as an assistant professor of religious studies at Arizona State University.

Potprecha Cholvijarn works in Buddhist and religious studies. He studied at Chulalongkorn University and the University of Bristol under Rupert Gethin. At Chulalongkorn University, he served as a special lecturer (attested 2011) and MA program chair in 2024.
